segments.comment: Independent seed found by scanning seeds 5520000-5520029 with the port for a D:3 shop whose door is closed (Healer, so the hero carries enough gold to pay). After the wizard-mode level teleport, Ctrl-T places the hero at (75,13), north of the closed door at (75,14). The hero kicks south until C's rolls let kick_door() succeed on the fifth kick: the door crashes open (a shop door never shatters), add_damage() bills SHOP_DOOR_COST, and pay_for_damage() brings the shopkeeper to the door to ask for 400 zorkmids. The hero pays, the shopkeeper returns home, and one search turn follows.
